## Poster Brief: IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings

### Overview

This poster distills the most critical findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report (2023) for presentation at a climate science conference. The audience is academic researchers and policymakers who are data-literate and expect rigorous, evidence-based communication. The core message: **climate change is unequivocal, accelerating, and the window for meaningful action is rapidly closing.**

### Key Priorities

- The **seven headline metrics** (temperature rise, CO₂ concentration, emissions, carbon budget, required reductions, sea level rise, and exposed population) should be the visual anchor of the poster — treat them as the centerpiece. The stat **"3.3–3.6 billion people exposed to severe climate hazards"** and the **"43% reduction by 2030"** figure should hit hardest.
- The narrative arc should flow from observed changes → projections → risks → solutions → urgency. Each section builds the case; the final "Narrowing Window" section should feel like a culmination, not an afterthought.
- Future projections across SSP scenarios deserve a clear visual treatment — think diverging pathway lines or a scenario comparison strip.

### Visual & Style Guidance

- **Palette:** Deep navy and slate backgrounds with warm-to-hot accent colors (amber, vermilion, deep red) to evoke warming severity. Use cool blues/teals sparingly for adaptation/solution elements.
- **Mood:** Authoritative, urgent but not alarmist. Clean academic typography — sans-serif headings, generous whitespace, structured grid.
- **Layout feel:** A0 portrait with a clear top-down hierarchy. Metric callouts should use large, bold numerals. Avoid clutter; let the data breathe.
- **Branding context:** Reference IPCC visual language — restrained, institutional, trustworthy.

2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for poster requirements, sections, metrics, and style definitions.

1. Output the final poster to `/app/output/final_poster.png`.
2. The poster must be a single self-contained image file.

2	
3	## Overview
4	
5	The IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) Synthesis Report, published in 2023 by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, integrates findings from three Working Group contributions and three Special Reports produced during the AR6 cycle. It represents the most comprehensive scientific assessment of climate change to date, covering the physical science basis, impacts and adaptation, and mitigation. The report underscores that human-caused climate change is already affecting every region on Earth, with widespread and intensifying consequences.
6	
7	## Observed Changes and Current State
8	
9	Global surface temperature rose by approximately **1.1°C** between the period 2011–2020 relative to the pre-industrial baseline of 1850–1900. Atmospheric CO₂ concentrations reached **410 ppm in 2019**, the highest level in at least 2 million years. Total global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions stood at approximately **59 GtCO₂-equivalent in 2019**, with fossil fuel combustion and land-use change as the dominant sources.
10	
11	| Indicator | Observed Value | Reference Period |
12	|---|---|---|
13	| Global surface temperature rise | +1.1°C | 2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900 |
14	| Atmospheric CO₂ | 410 ppm | 2019 |
15	| Global GHG emissions | ~59 GtCO₂e | 2019 |
16	| Sea level rise | ~0.20 m | 1901–2018 |
17	| Arctic sea ice (September) decline | ~40% area loss | 1979–2020 |
18	
19	Every region of the world has experienced increases in the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events, including heatwaves, heavy precipitation, droughts, and tropical cyclones, with clear attribution to human influence.
20	
21	## Future Projections Under Different Scenarios
22	
23	The AR6 uses Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to project future climate outcomes. Under the very low emissions scenario (SSP1-1.9), global warming is likely to reach 1.5°C in the near term before declining slightly by 2100. Under the very high emissions scenario (SSP5-8.5), warming could exceed **4.4°C by 2100**.
24	
25	| Scenario | Projected Warming by 2100 (best estimate) | Description |
26	|---|---|---|
27	| SSP1-1.9 | ~1.4°C | Very low emissions, sustainability focus |
28	| SSP1-2.6 | ~1.8°C | Low emissions |
29	| SSP2-4.5 | ~2.7°C | Intermediate emissions |
30	| SSP3-7.0 | ~3.6°C | High emissions |
31	| SSP5-8.5 | ~4.4°C | Very high emissions, fossil-fuel intensive |
32	
33	Sea level is projected to rise by 0.28–0.55 m under SSP1-1.9 and 0.63–1.01 m under SSP5-8.5 by 2100, with continued rise for centuries to millennia regardless of pathway.
34	
35	## Risks, Vulnerabilities, and Cascading Impacts
36	
37	Approximately **3.3 to 3.6 billion people** live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change. Climate hazards increasingly interact with non-climatic stressors—poverty, inequality, ecosystem degradation—to produce cascading and compounding risks. Biodiversity loss accelerates beyond 1.5°C, with up to 14% of terrestrial species facing very high extinction risk at 1.5°C of warming, rising sharply at higher levels.
38	
39	- **Food security**: Crop yield growth rates have slowed in many regions, and fisheries productivity is declining in tropical zones.
40	- **Water stress**: Over half the world's population currently experiences severe water scarcity for at least one month per year.
41	- **Health**: Heat-related mortality and vector-borne disease ranges are expanding.
42	
43	## Mitigation and Adaptation Pathways
44	
45	To limit warming to **1.5°C with no or limited overshoot**, global GHG emissions must be reduced by **43% below 2019 levels by 2030** and reach **net zero CO₂ by around 2050**. For a 2°C target, emissions must fall by 27% by 2030 and reach net zero CO₂ by around 2070.
46	
47	Key mitigation levers include rapid decarbonization of energy systems, electrification of transport, demand-side efficiency improvements, and protection and restoration of carbon sinks. The remaining carbon budget from the start of 2020 for a 50% chance of limiting warming to 1.5°C is approximately **500 GtCO₂**.
48	
49	## The Narrowing Window for Action
50	
51	The synthesis report emphasizes that the choices made in this decade will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C or 2°C. Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces feasibility of limiting warming. Climate finance flows remain insufficient—falling short of needs by a factor of 3 to 6 for adaptation alone. Immediate, deep, and sustained emissions reductions across all sectors are essential to secure a liveable and sustainable future for all.
52

    /* ===== FEATURED METRICS (full-width callouts) ===== */
    .featured-metrics {

    .featured-metric {

      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.15);

    .featured-metric .big-stat {

      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      line-height: 1;

    .featured-metric.critical .big-stat { color: var(--negative); }
    .featured-metric.urgent .big-stat { color: var(--accent); }
    .featured-metric .stat-label {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .featured-metric .stat-label strong {
      color: var(--text);

    /* ===== SCENARIO TABLE ===== */
    .scenario-strip {
      display: flex;

    }
    .scenario-item {
      flex: 1;

      text-align: center;

      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    html.theme-dark .scenario-item { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border); }
    .scenario-item:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }
    .scenario-item::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--ssp-color, #888);
      border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
    }
    .ssp-name {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .ssp-temp {
      font-size: 1.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: var(--ssp-color, var(--text));
    }
    .ssp-desc {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    /* ===== CHART SECTION ===== */
    .chart-container {
      padding: 32px 28px;
      min-height: 360px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
      container-type: inline-size;
    }
    .chart-container:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .chart-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .chart-subtitle { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 20px; }

    /* ===== TWO-COL LAYOUT ===== */
    .two-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; }
    .three-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }

    /* ===== RISK LIST ===== */
    .risk-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .risk-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 22px 20px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .risk-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .risk-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1);
    }
    .risk-icon.amber { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); }
    .risk-icon.teal { background: rgba(20,184,166,0.12); }
    .risk-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .risk-card h4 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .risk-card p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.55; }

    /* ===== MITIGATION PATHWAY ===== */
    .pathway-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr 1fr auto;
      gap: 0;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 18px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .pathway-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .pathway-target {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .pathway-bar-wrap {
      padding: 0 20px;
    }
    .pathway-bar {
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: var(--border);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .pathway-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 4px;
      transition: width 0.6s ease;
    }
    .pathway-stats {
      text-align: right;
      padding-right: 20px;
    }
    .pathway-stats .val {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }
    .pathway-stats .sub {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .pathway-net-zero {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ===== NARROWING WINDOW / FOOTER CTA ===== */
    .cta-section {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 40px 44px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    html.theme-dark .cta-section {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(220,38,38,0.07) 0%, rgba(245,158,11,0.05) 100%);
      border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.18);
    }
    html.theme-light .cta-section {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(220,38,38,0.04) 0%, rgba(245,158,11,0.04) 100%);
      border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.12);
    }
    .cta-section h2 {
      font-size: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cta-bullets {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }
    .cta-bullet {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .cta-bullet .bullet-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--negative);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .cta-bullet .bullet-dot.amber { background: var(--accent); }
    .cta-bullet .bullet-dot.teal { background: var(--teal); }

    /* ===== POSTER FOOTER ===== */
    .poster-footer {
      margin-top: 48px;
      padding-top: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .poster-footer p {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .ipcc-badge {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .ipcc-badge .badge-block {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }
    .animate { animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out both; }
    .animate.delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.08s; }
    .animate.delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.16s; }
    .animate.delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.24s; }
    .animate.delay-4 { animation-delay: 0.32s; }
    .animate.delay-5 { animation-delay: 0.40s; }
    .animate.delay-6 { animation-delay: 0.48s; }
    .animate.delay-7 { animation-delay: 0.56s; }

    .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease; }
    .reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
      .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    /* ===== SR-ONLY ===== */
    .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }

    /* ===== MENU ===== */
    .viz-menu { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 9999; }
    .viz-menu-toggle {
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; display: flex;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .viz-menu-toggle:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }
    .viz-menu-dropdown {
      position: absolute; top: 52px; right: 0; min-width: 200px;
      background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px;
      opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: all 0.2s; backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .viz-menu-dropdown.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
    .viz-menu-dropdown button {
      width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px;
      background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-size: 14px;
      font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .viz-menu-dropdown button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }

    /* ===== PRINT ===== */
    @media print {
      body { background: white !important; color: black !important; }
      .viz-menu { display: none !important; }
      .reveal { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
      .card, .metric-card, .risk-card, .scenario-item { break-inside: avoid; }
      * { print-color-adjust: exact; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; }
    }
    @page { margin: 0.75in; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1140px) {
      .poster { width: 100%; padding: 40px 32px; }
      .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .metrics-grid-bottom { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .poster { padding: 24px 20px; }
      h1, .poster-title { font-size: 2rem; }
      h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
      .featured-metrics { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .two-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .three-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .risk-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .scenario-strip { flex-direction: column; }
      .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .metrics-grid-bottom { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .cta-bullets { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .pathway-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
      .featured-metric .big-stat { font-size: 3rem; }
      .poster-footer { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 375px) {
      body { overflow-x: hidden; }
      .metrics-grid, .metrics-grid-bottom { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .metric-value { font-size: 1.75rem; }
    }
  </style>

    .pathway-row {

    }

    .ipcc-badge .badge-block {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }
    .animate { animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out both; }
    .animate.delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.08s; }
    .animate.delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.16s; }
    .animate.delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.24s; }
    .animate.delay-4 { animation-delay: 0.32s; }
    .animate.delay-5 { animation-delay: 0.40s; }
    .animate.delay-6 { animation-delay: 0.48s; }
    .animate.delay-7 { animation-delay: 0.56s; }

    .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease; }
    .reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
      .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    /* ===== SR-ONLY ===== */
    .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }

    /* ===== MENU ===== */
    .viz-menu { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 9999; }
    .viz-menu-toggle {
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; display: flex;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .viz-menu-toggle:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }
    .viz-menu-dropdown {
      position: absolute; top: 52px; right: 0; min-width: 200px;
      background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px;
      opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: all 0.2s; backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .viz-menu-dropdown.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
    .viz-menu-dropdown button {
      width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px;
      background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-size: 14px;
      font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .viz-menu-dropdown button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }

    /* ===== PRINT ===== */
    @media print {
      body { background: white !important; color: black !important; }
      .viz-menu { display: none !important; }
      .reveal { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
      .card, .metric-card, .risk-card, .scenario-item { break-inside: avoid; }
      * { print-color-adjust: exact; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; }
    }
    @page { margin: 0.75in; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1140px) {
      .poster { width: 100%; padding: 40px 32px; }
      .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .metrics-grid-bottom { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .poster { padding: 24px 20px; }
      h1, .poster-title { font-size: 2rem; }
      h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
      .featured-metrics { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .two-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .three-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .risk-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .scenario-strip { flex-direction: column; }
      .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .metrics-grid-bottom { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .cta-bullets { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .pathway-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
      .featured-metric .big-stat { font-size: 3rem; }
      .poster-footer { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 375px) {
      body { overflow-x: hidden; }
      .metrics-grid, .metrics-grid-bottom { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .metric-value { font-size: 1.75rem; }
    }
  </style>

  <main id="main-content" role="main">
    <div class="poster">

      <!-- ============================
           HEADER
      ============================= -->
      <header class="poster-header animate" role="banner">
        <div class="header-badge">
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/></svg>

        <div class="header-meta">

          <span>

            234 Lead Authors · 195 Member Governments
          </span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- ============================
           SECTION 1: HEADLINE METRICS
      ============================= -->
      <section aria-labelledby="metrics-heading">
        <div class="section-label">Seven Headline Metrics</div>
        <div class="section-title">
          <h2 id="metrics-heading">The State of Our Climate</h2>
          <p>Observed changes spanning global temperature, atmospheric composition, emissions, sea level, and human exposure to climate hazards.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- Big featured callouts first -->
        <div class="featured-metrics animate delay-1">
          <div class="featured-metric critical" role="region" aria-label="Population exposed to climate hazards">
            <div class="big-stat" data-count="3300000000" data-suffix="">3.3–3.6B</div>
            <div class="stat-label">people live in contexts <strong>highly vulnerable</strong> to climate change — over 40% of humanity exposed to severe climate hazards</div>
          </div>
          <div class="featured-metric urgent" role="region" aria-label="Required emissions reduction by 2030">
            <div class="big-stat">43%</div>
            <div class="stat-label">reduction in global GHG emissions required <strong>by 2030</strong> to limit warming to 1.5°C — the defining challenge of this decade</div>

            <svg class="metric-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M12 22a8 8 0 0 1-8-8V5a8 8 0 0 1 16 0v9a8 8 0 0 1-8 8z"/><line x1="12" y1="10" x2="12" y2="14"/></svg>

      --bg: #0c1220;
      --surface: #111827;
      --surface-hover: #1a2436;
      --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      --text: #EDEDED;

      --vermilion: #dc2626;

      --border: rgba(0,0,0,0.08);

    .pathway-row {
      display: grid;

    .pathway-stats {
      text-align: right;

      font-size: 1.25rem;

    }

    @keyframes fadeInUp {
